title: Initial questionnaire
description: Health, lifestyle and goals so we can design a safe programme. Please answer honestly; this information is treated confidentially.

questions.prompt: Do you have any allergies? List them below
Have you had an injury in the last year? List them below
Do you take any medication daily or regularly? List drugs and doses
Has a health professional ever told you not to do a certain exercise or movement? Tell us about it
Have you had any medical procedure or pregnancy in the last 5 years? List them below
Describe your physical activity in a typical week
Have you trained before? Describe your experience
How many times do you eat per day? Describe the meals in a typical day
Describe your main physical goals and why they matter to you now. If there are several, rank them by priority
Which days and times would you like to train?
How many times would you like to train per week?
Do you have training equipment at home? List it
Is there anything else you want to tell us before your first session?

I, ______________________________, declare that the information given in this form is true and complete, and that I have disclosed all relevant medical conditions, injuries, medication and allergies. I understand that physical exercise involves risks and that withholding information may endanger my health. I authorise Héctor Bordajandi Moleón to contact my emergency person or medical services if needed during training.

I also authorise Héctor Bordajandi Moleón, NIF 48722797B, email bordamtg@gmail.com, to process my personal and health data solely to design and supervise my training and manage the professional relationship. The legal basis is my explicit consent (art. 6.1.a and art. 9.2.a GDPR) and performance of the service contract (art. 6.1.b GDPR).
